PageSections.ParagraphContentHTML: Data isn't just numbers. It's names, addresses, product descriptions, email conversations, financial transactions, sensor readings, click patterns, voice recordings, images, documents, and millions of other information types.

PageSections.SectionTitleH2: The Three Types of Business Data
PageSections.SectionNotes: Structured Data (20% of org data, rows/columns), Unstructured Data (80%, emails/docs/videos), Semi-Structured (growing, XML/JSON/logs/IoT).
People (roles, accountability), Process (workflows, request/report/propose), Technology (catalogs, monitoring, enforcement).

Myth 1: 'It's an IT project' (Reality: business initiative). Myth 2: 'Govern all data' (Reality: start critical). Myth 3: 'Slows things down' (Reality: accelerates via trust). Myth 4: 'Buy a tool and done' (Reality: people+process+tech).
